(SELECT PARAMETER_VALUE FROM AZ_PARAMETERS WHERE PARAMETER_NAME = 'GMD_Foreach_Loop_Container_ContainerName' AND PIPELINE_NAME = 'ppl_calypso_live_trade') AS GMD_Foreach_Loop_Container_ContainerName,

-- Exec [dbo].[sp_CIRC_LiveTrade_Updte_Keyword]

    UPDATE [ReconControl].[dbo].[tbl_CIRC_LiveTrade] 
    SET [ReconControl].[dbo].[tbl_CIRC_LiveTrade].[Product Description] = [ReconControl].[dbo].[tbl_CIRC_LiveTrade_KeywordUpdate].[Product Description]
      ,[ReconControl].[dbo].[tbl_CIRC_LiveTrade].[RP] = [ReconControl].[dbo].[tbl_CIRC_LiveTrade_KeywordUpdate].[RP]
      ,[ReconControl].[dbo].[tbl_CIRC_LiveTrade].[Orig_CPTY] = [ReconControl].[dbo].[tbl_CIRC_LiveTrade_KeywordUpdate].[Orig_CPTY]
      ,[ReconControl].[dbo].[tbl_CIRC_LiveTrade].[PM_Response] = [ReconControl].[dbo].[tbl_CIRC_LiveTrade_KeywordUpdate].[PM_Response]
      ,[ReconControl].[dbo].[tbl_CIRC_LiveTrade].[product_Family] = [ReconControl].[dbo].[tbl_CIRC_LiveTrade_KeywordUpdate].[product_Family]
    FROM [ReconControl].[dbo].[tbl_CIRC_LiveTrade] join [ReconControl].[dbo].[tbl_CIRC_LiveTrade_KeywordUpdate]
    on  [ReconControl].[dbo].[tbl_CIRC_LiveTrade].[Trade ID] = [dbo].[tbl_CIRC_LiveTrade_KeywordUpdate].[Trade ID]

-- execute [dbo].[sp_CIRC_LiveTrade_Rates_Load];


 
 --delete all records from previous business date
DECLARE @Deleted_Rows2 INT;  
SET @Deleted_Rows2 = 1;

WHILE (@Deleted_Rows2 > 0)
  BEGIN
   BEGIN TRANSACTION
   -- Delete some small number of rows at a time
     DELETE TOP (100000) [ReconControl].[dbo].[tbl_CIRC_RTS_LiveTrade]
     SET @Deleted_Rows2 = @@ROWCOUNT;
   COMMIT TRANSACTION
END
